# Product context

**Biograph** (repo `fossibleworks/biograph`, which Build calls *fossibleHIS*) is an open-source **Hospital Information System (HIS)**. It is a fork of Marley Health with added features, maintained by Tacten/Fossibleworks. It is installed as the Frappe app `healthcare` (app title "Biograph") and needs **ERPNext** (`required_apps = ["frappe/erpnext"]`).

## Who uses it
- **Clinical and front-desk staff** at clinics and hospitals: practitioners, nurses, lab technicians and reception. They work in the Frappe Desk at `/desk/healthcare`. After login, `on_login` sends each role to its own home page.
- **Patients** use the Vue **Patient Portal** (`/patient-portal`). There they see appointments, book and pay for visits, and view diagnostic reports.

## Domain
- Patient management, outpatient and inpatient workflows (Patient Appointment, Patient Encounter, Inpatient Record, Discharge Summary).
- Clinical procedures, rehabilitation and physiotherapy (therapy plans and sessions), and the laboratory (Lab Test, Sample Collection, Observation, Diagnostic Report).
- Medication requests, service requests and orders. Insurance covers payors, contracts, coverage and claims.
- Medical code standards (Code System, Code Value). The design follows **HL7 FHIR**.
- Facilities are modelled as **Healthcare Service Units**, and specialities as **Medical Departments**.
- India regional support covers **ABDM** (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) integration (`healthcare/regional/india/abdm`).
- ERPNext supplies billing (Sales Invoice, Payment Entry), stock/pharmacy, HR and accounts. Biograph hooks into these.

The repo has about 138 DocTypes, plus reports, dashboards, workspaces and print formats.
